chapters.reason: The paper uses attention patterns to probe distinct computational roles of different layers in multi-step reasoning, aligning with micro-level observation of functional differentiation in reasoning processes.

The study analyzes how intermediate layers form specialized sub-circuits for reasoning, as evidenced by recovering reasoning trees from attention, indicating their core role in latent Chain-of-Thought.
The probing of attention patterns investigates how information flows across layers during reasoning, though it focuses more on layer roles than generalized theories of cross-layer transmission.
